tools.description: Report tool version, host info, and which tuning capabilities are available.
tools.name: get_capabilities

tools.description: Read thermal pressure and (when available) temperatures and fan RPM.
tools.name: get_sensors

tools.description: Read battery health: charge %, cycle count, capacity, condition — plus Apple's own Maximum Capacity/Condition when available.
tools.name: get_battery

tools.description: List displays with EDR headroom (extended-brightness capability).
tools.name: list_displays

tools.description: Read system metrics: CPU utilization, memory pressure, boot disk usage, mounted storage volumes (names, paths, capacity), network throughput, and GPU device utilization percent (gpu.utilization_percent, when the IORegistry publishes it), and power. The power block separates two quantities: system_watts is the total power the whole Mac consumes (SMC PSTR, else the battery's SystemLoad; also valid on battery), while volts/amps/watts (adapter_watts) are adapter DC-in input only and read ~0 on battery. Fields the Mac does not expose are absent.
tools.name: get_system_metrics

tools.description: List the processes currently using the most CPU, memory or GPU — the answer to "what is making this Mac hot/slow?". CPU is a rate measured between two samples taken about a second apart. Processes owned by another user (root) are counted in unreadable_process_count but cannot be inspected without elevation.
tools.name: get_top_processes

tools.description: Read AI subscription/token usage per provider (OpenRouter, …). Read-only; never returns credential material. Unconfigured providers report as not set up. This tool takes no arguments and always queries every catalog provider through symbrain (credential/local-auth discovery included), regardless of which providers are enabled in the Cockpit app. To limit discovery to one provider, use the CLI: `symcockpit ai-usage <provider>`.
tools.name: get_ai_usage

tools.description: Start or stop a keep-awake session. Prevents idle/system sleep and optionally display sleep. Runs indefinitely without duration_seconds. Returns full session state.

duration_seconds.description: Optional session duration in seconds, between 0 and 86400 (24 hours). Omit for an indefinite session.

enabled.description: Set to true to start a session, false to end it.

prevent_display_sleep.description: When true, also prevent display sleep.

tools.name: keep_awake

tools.description: Return the current keep-awake session state (active, type, remaining time, reason).
tools.name: keep_awake_status

tools.description: Read the built-in display brightness (0.0–1.0).
tools.name: get_brightness

tools.description: Save current settings as a named profile.
tools.name: save_profile

tools.description: Apply a saved profile by name.
tools.name: load_profile

tools.description: List all saved profiles.
tools.name: list_profiles

tools.description: Delete a saved profile by name.
tools.name: delete_profile

tools.description: Get the consolidated health status snapshot of the system, including score, recommendations, overrides, and raw reports.
tools.name: get_status

tools.description: Retrieve the write operations history log.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 100).

tools.name: get_history
